data.name: Haunted Lakes of Austin
data.detailed_description:
Title: Haunted Lakes of Austin

Camera: Third-person (boating + fishing + walking + swimming switching)

BOAT, FISH, SURVIVE

Haunted Lakes of Austin is a light horror, exploration, and survival fishing adventure set across real-world lakes in Central Texas—twisted by legend, mystery, and supernatural forces.

Explore haunted waters, uncover hidden secrets, and survive what lurks beneath.

Story

Something is wrong with the lakes.

What were once peaceful waters have become cursed—whispers echo across the surface, ghost lights flicker in the distance, and long-forgotten places are rising from below.

You play as Mariner Marge or Skipper Steve, drawn into a growing supernatural mystery tied to real locations and local legends. Each lake holds a piece of the truth—from sunken cemeteries to lost underwater structures—leading toward something far bigger beneath the surface.

The Lakes Grow Darker

From the quiet shores of Lake Georgetown, where ghostly fishermen drift above a hidden underwater cemetery, to the shadowed depths of Granger Lake, where drowned trees seem to move on their own, each lake introduces new legends and growing danger. At Canyon Lake, players descend into submerged caves rumored to hold an entire lost town, while Lady Bird Lake twists familiar city lights into eerie reflections filled with unseen watchers beneath the surface. Lake Austin brings shifting currents and phantom boaters, and Lake Travis erupts with chaotic supernatural energy—haunted party coves, massive creatures, and violent encounters that test survival. As players push onward through Lake Marble Falls, Lake LBJ, Inks Lake, and finally Lake Buchanan, the waters grow darker, enemies more aggressive, and exploration more dangerous—introducing larger monsters, harsher resource management, and deeper, more complex secrets. Each lake builds on the last, turning a quiet fishing trip into a fight to survive what lies beneath.

Core Gameplay

At its heart, Haunted Lakes of Austin blends:

• 🚤 Boat Exploration – Navigate fully explorable lakes based on real geography

• 🎣 Fishing with Purpose – Catch fish, treasure, and cursed items

• 🧭 Discovery & Navigation – Use maps, compass hints, and environmental clues

• 👻 Supernatural Encounters – Avoid, escape, or survive ghostly threats

• 💡 Resource Management – Balance health, light, and inventory to stay alive

Progression & Goals

• Explore 10 unique lakes, each with its own theme, layout, and secrets

• Unlock new tools like upgraded fishing gear, lanterns, and navigation items

• Collect treasure chests and rare artifacts to progress

• Discover hidden areas and unlock new lake levels

• Survive increasingly dangerous supernatural events

Your goal: uncover the truth behind the curse—and make it out alive.

Game Mechanics

• 🎣 Fishing System

• Catch fish for health boosts

• Catch cursed fish that drain health

• Rare catches provide major advantages—or risks

• ⚡ Cursed Item System (Blue Voltage)

• Powerful items with supernatural effects

• Risk vs reward gameplay (buffs + penalties)

• Visually enhanced with signature Blue Voltage glow

• 🧰 Inventory & Equipment

• Manage tools, keys, bait, and survival gear

• Unlock upgrades that change how you explore

• 🌊 Dynamic Water & Exploration

• Hidden underwater zones

• Secret fishing locations

• Environmental storytelling

Challenges

• Increasingly aggressive supernatural entities

• Limited light in dark environments

• Navigating large open water with minimal guidance

• Managing cursed effects and survival resources

• Finding required items to progress each lake

Game Modes

• 🎮 Story Mode

• Full progression across all haunted lakes

• 🧭 Exploration Mode

• Freely explore unlocked lakes without progression pressure

(Optional future expansion potential: Survival Mode, Timed Runs, Co-op exploration)

Playtime

• Main Story: ~8–12 hours

• Completionist: 15–20+ hours

• Replayability: Multiple paths, hidden areas, and item combinations

Soundtrack & Atmosphere

• Ambient, eerie soundscapes inspired by real lake environments

• Subtle supernatural audio cues that guide (or mislead) the player

• Light horror tone—focused on tension and mystery rather than gore

What Makes It Unique

• 🌎 Real Lakes, Reimagined

Built from actual lake maps and real-world locations around Austin, Texas

• 🎣 Fishing Meets Survival Horror

A rare blend of relaxing gameplay and supernatural tension

• ⚡ Blue Voltage System

Signature visual and gameplay mechanic tied to cursed energy and items

• 👻 Legend-Based Design

Inspired by real ghost stories, underwater towns, and local myths

• 🗺️ Exploration-Driven Gameplay

No hand-holding—players uncover the world through curiosity and discovery

Final Hook

Relax… if you can.

Because on these lakes—

you’re not alone.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10 or higher
  • Processor: i7 8700 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card with the latest drivers

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4650U, Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000, 1.5GB

Recommended:
  • OS: MacOS Big Sur 11.4
